beats.say: The journey to make Ready Player One began back in 2010.
Warner Bros. Entertainment first acquired the rights to the book that year.
In July 2015, Steven Spielberg signed on to direct and produce.
Filming started in England in June 2016, finishing that September.
The film eventually featured many popular culture references throughout the story.
It finally premiered at South by Southwest on 11 March 2018.

facts: Development of the film began in mid-2010 when Warner Bros. Entertainment acquired the rights to the book
In July 2015, Spielberg signed on to direct and produce the film
Filming began in England in June 2016 and was completed in September that year
Many popular culture references appear throughout the film
Ready Player One premiered at South by Southwest in Austin, Texas on 11 March 2018
